brief: A note-taking app in 3D space — recent notes float near, old ones drift away, connections are threads

dominant_strengths: Strong depth metaphor — fading distant cards and glowing thread streaks evoke memory drifting through space convincingly
Restrained accent palette (coral, teal, amber) reads as a coherent indexing system against the deep navy void
Card hierarchy via colored left-edge bars cleanly encodes category without adding chrome
dominant_weaknesses: The promised 'threads' between notes are barely present — only horizontal light streaks, no real connection topology visible
Distant cards overlap and collide rather than gracefully receding; reads as clutter instead of perspective
Typography is generic system sans with weak scale contrast; titles and meta share too similar a weight rhythm
fix_priorities: Render actual curved thread connections between semantically linked notes — core to the brief
Establish real 3D perspective transforms (scale, blur, parallax) so old notes feel spatially distant, not just smaller
Tighten typographic hierarchy with a distinctive display face for titles and lighter meta treatment
Resolve overlap collisions on far-plane cards with z-sorted occlusion or graceful fade-to-edge
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral spatial wow lands first, but behavioral usability suffers from overlapping unreadable cards, while reflective concept (memory as space) is the strongest layer.
rationale.intent_fit: Partially fits — the floating depth metaphor is legible, but the 'connections as threads' pillar is essentially missing, leaving the concept half-built.
